title: Asiad: PH baseball medal hopes end in shutout loss to Japan
summary: The Philippines bowed to host Japan, 7-0, to close out the group stage of the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Wednesday at the Toyohashi Municipal Baseball Stadium in Aichi Prefecture.
